quote.text: There is an error; but it is merely the accidental error of mistaking the abstract for the concrete.
quote.author: Alfred North Whitehead, Science and the Modern World (1925), naming the Fallacy of Misplaced Concreteness

stories.headline: Briarcliff opens Christmas at the Kringles to a zero on Rotten Tomatoes
stories.dek: Twenty-six reviews, not one of them positive, and a $370,000 Friday — in the same weekend LAIKA’s Wildwood passed twenty million dollars at ninety-nine per cent.

stories.headline: Ikebana lost three-quarters of Japan’s practitioners in thirty-five years
stories.dek: The Statistics Bureau counted 6.04 million in 1986 and 1.39 million in 2021 — and among 25- to 29-year-olds the participation rate fell from 9.2 per cent to 0.4.

stories.headline: Singapore Airlines pushes its Dubai restart to March 2027, a fourth delay
stories.dek: SQ494 and SQ495 are now cancelled through 28 February, making a full year without a Singapore–Dubai flight — and the A380 freed by it has gone to Auckland instead.

stories.headline: TRM Labs attributes the Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor unit
stories.dek: Richard Teng says Binance has replaced 90 per cent of the $6.36bn; about $2.7bn is frozen by the stablecoin issuers, and $2.4bn in bitcoin and ether is beyond their reach.

stories.headline: Wilmar and Golden Agri agree to fund Singapore’s haze assessors
stories.dek: Five of the ten companies served notices had said yes by 31 October, two more are expected — and the Government says it will publish who cooperates and who does not.

stories.headline: A Kinex square beats Woodpeckers’ on squareness for twenty dollars less
stories.dek: Woodpeckers publishes one thousandth of an inch per foot on an $89.99 aluminium square; Kinex publishes less than half that error on a $69.99 steel one, in the same length.

stories.headline: US agencies surveilled Megaspeed’s Alice Huang over her closeness to Nvidia
stories.dek: The New York Times reported on 29 October that officials suspected the former executive of a Singapore data-centre firm of gathering information for Beijing. Nvidia says the allegations were debunked last year.

stories.headline: Apple charges US$11,500 to double the Mac Studio’s memory to 512 gigabytes
stories.dek: Orders opened on 28 October at US$22,299 and ship from late November; Apple’s Singapore store does not list the configuration at all, so there is no local price.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · The Two-Day Sell-Out
stories.headline: The Futur Antérieur sells out in two days at 4,950 francs
stories.dek: Both 178-piece references of the Louis Erard × Vianney Halter watch were waitlisted by 1 November, two days after a launch this desk reported on Saturday — at a price 41 per cent above the 2020 collaboration.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The Screen Rules
stories.headline: Screen rules buy back 56 minutes a day, Oregon researchers find
stories.dek: Eight thousand American adolescents, tracked for three years: the strictest parents saw an hour less screen time — and the gap closed by 13 minutes with every year the child aged.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · Gold And The Real Yield
stories.headline: Gold falls to a one-year low as Treasury real yields drop
stories.dek: Spot gold closed 30 October at $3,874, down 3.6 per cent in a day — while the United States Treasury’s ten-year real yield fell 28 basis points across the month.

stories.headline: A Melbourne trial finds Achilles injections no better than a sham
stories.dek: The Inject trial put 192 adults of average age 49 into three arms for twelve months: the steroid group led at six weeks, trailed by six months, and was level at a year.

stories.headline: Gardens by the Bay confirms Christmas Wonderland for 27 November
stories.dek: Supertree Grove and The Meadow, to 3 January, 6.30pm to 11 — and ticket prices are still unpublished, where a year ago they were already selling from nine dollars.

stories.headline: South Korea pays shrinking counties for visitors who stay three hours
stories.dek: The “living population” counts anyone present three hours in a month. In Yangyang it outnumbers residents 17.6 to one — and this year it entered the formula for the country’s largest block grant.
